summary.intent: Wire CTR encryption mode into the SDK's uploadFile() so that large media files use AES-CTR streaming encryption instead of always defaulting to AES-GCM, enabling the streaming playback pipeline.
summary.outcome: CTR encryption is now selected by MIME type + size in both the SDK client and web app, sdk-core pre-existing test type errors were fixed, the previously-skipped E2E CTR badge test passes, and a PR was opened targeting fix/e2e-test-failures-v2. A follow-up FLAC MIME type omission was caught and fixed in the same branch.

repo: selectEncryptionMode() existed only in the web app's streaming-crypto.service.ts and was never wired into the SDK — duplicate logic was required in packages/sdk/src/client.ts
sdk-core build output must be rebuilt before typechecking the sdk package, since sdk imports compiled types from sdk-core dist
The STREAMING_MIME_TYPES set existed in two places (sdk/src/client.ts and apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts) and must be kept in sync manually
audio/flac was missing from STREAMING_MIME_TYPES in both locations
The CTR badge test in streaming-playback.spec.ts was intentionally skipped pending this fix

code.finding: uploadFile() hardcoded encryptAesGcm and encryptionMode: 'GCM'; needed optional encryptionMode param to branch to encryptAesCtr + generateCtrIv
uploadFile() never determined encryption mode before delegating to sdkCore; mode selection logic added here
Reference implementation of selectEncryptionMode() with MIME type list and 256KB threshold
PublishIpnsResponseDto lost its cid field; ResolveIpnsResponseDto lost its source field — mocks were stale
addToIpfs mock was returning {cid} but IpfsAddResult requires {cid, size, recorded}

workflow: Rebuilding sdk-core before typechecking sdk is a required step when sdk-core types change
The Vite dev server picks up rebuilt workspace package changes via HMR without restart
E2E tests can be run directly against the local dev stack without needing a separate test environment

friction: sdk typecheck failed on first attempt because sdk-core dist was stale — required an explicit build step before the error resolved
STREAMING_MIME_TYPES is duplicated across sdk and web app with no shared source of truth, making it easy to miss updates (demonstrated by the FLAC omission)
open_items: PR #399 targets fix/e2e-test-failures-v2, not main — needs retargeting or merge coordination once that branch lands
STREAMING_MIME_TYPES duplication between sdk/src/client.ts and apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts should be consolidated into a shared package to prevent future drift
The 13 other pending todos remain, including the Web Worker encryption offload, ERC-1271 wallet auth, CRDT IPNS inbox, and several other testing todos
